ui_basic_colours.meaning: Section caption above built-in 48-swatch grid:16 predefined RGB colours plus32 HSV-derived colours. A swatch click updates current ColourValue and syncs the preview; it does not by itself save a custom slot.
complete_context: AdvancedColourDialog.kt: show basics array, swatch callback, sync; nested ColourValue
ui_basic_colours.qualification: Basic denotes supplied standard choice set, not a scientific primary-colour-only set or elementary colour theory. Caption, not action; plural retained.

ui_selected_colour23.meaning: Caption beside current sample preview. The sample draws value.colour; sync invalidates it after current selection/field changes. The selected value may be provisional before final acceptance.
complete_context: AdvancedColourDialog.kt: show sampleColumn/sample.onDraw, sync, positive callback and cancel/dismiss handlers
ui_selected_colour23.qualification: Selected is a current-state description, not Select colour imperative, not original colour or saved palette colour. Invalid field input may retain last valid preview. No rendering outcome certified.

ui_add_colour26.meaning: Colour-tab Add colour opens custom-slot workflow. First empty slot is selected; if full, user chooses a slot to replace. In a new-slot dialog the same label serves title and positive action. After valid fields, positive callback stores current opaque colour, refreshes palette and makes it foreground.
complete_context: AdvancedColourDialog.kt: show conditional title/positive label, validation and commit
ui_add_colour26.qualification: Not paint/add pixels immediately, not adding a new layer. Outer action opens dialog; inner action commits. Full-palette route may replace existing slot; no promise of increasing slot count. Separate Add to palette key is outside scope.

ui_edit_colour26.meaning: Menu action for an existing saved custom-colour cell, and title for replacement dialog. Choosing it calls addColour(index), initializes existing colour and passes replacingPaletteColour=true; positive button in that mode is separately labeled Save.
ui_edit_colour26.qualification: Edits chosen saved swatch, not every pixel of that colour, whole-image colour adjustment or text formatting. Title/action share resource; retain functional editing semantics.

ui_use_colour.meaning: Positive dialog action when not adding/replacing a custom slot. After validation it accepts current colour and invokes caller commit for foreground or background, then dismisses. Preview changes may already have updated document colour property; cancel restores original preview.
complete_context: AdvancedColourDialog.kt: show positive listener, sync, cancel and dismiss
ui_use_colour.qualification: Use means apply the selected drawing/background colour, not save image or necessarily store a custom slot. Does not itself paint a stroke or recolour existing pixels. Separate custom-palette changes may persist independently; no blanket rollback promise.

limits: Inherited Palette and held fill/calligraphy proposals excluded.
No placeholders, units or ellipses in five selected labels.
